_comment: What the paper and the diner say when a part shop closes or opens (PartShopLifeService), and when a racer picks up
a bargain at a closing-down sale (OpponentLifeService). For the shops: {shop} its name, {region} where it is, {blurb}
its line on the map, {discount} the sale's cut in whole percent, {day} a date ({day:dddd} is the weekday: the sale's
last day, or today). For the racers, as in street.json, plus {part}, {shop} and {price}.
The map card and the shop's counter (partshop.*) say it one way: {discount} and {day} as above, {finalDays} how many
days the last, deeper cut runs. Haggling at a junkyard: {part}, {price} what it costs now, {was} what it cost before,

news.partshop_closing.headline: {shop} Closing Down
Everything Must Go at {shop}
Last Days for {shop}
news.partshop_closing.body: {shop} of {region} is going out of business. Every part in the place is {discount}% off until {day:dddd}, and cheaper still in the last three days.
The shelves at {shop} are for sale, shelves and all: {discount}% off everything through {day:dddd, MMMM d}. Hot rodders are already lining up.
news.partshop_closed.headline: {shop} Shuts Its Doors
No More Parts at {shop}
lines.news.partshop_closed.body: {shop} in {region} has closed. What was left went back to the wholesalers.
news.partshop_opened.headline: New Parts Shop in {region}
{shop} Opens for Business
news.partshop_reopened.headline: {shop} Is Back
Lights On Again at {shop}
lines.news.partshop_reopened.body: The old {shop} in {region} is open again, under new owners and the old name. {blurb}
street.partshop_closing: {shop} is closing down. Everything's {discount}% off till {day:dddd}.
Heard {shop} is going out of business? Get to {region} before the good parts go.
lines.street.partshop_last_days: Last days at {shop}: {discount}% off whatever's left, and it shuts after {day:dddd}.
street.partshop_opened: There's a new parts place in {region}: {shop}.
street.partshop_bargain: {name} picked up a {part} at {shop}'s closing-down sale for {price:money}.
{name} got a {part} cheap at {shop}'s closing-down sale and bolted it straight on.
lines.machine.no_pieces: Nothing to bring: no loose parts on your shelf and no engine on the stand. Take an engine out, or a part off, and come back.
lines.machine.no_jobs: Nothing this shop does on that.
lines.machine.left: {work} on the {part}: back in your garage {day:dddd, MMMM d}.
lines.machine.changed: That job is not what it was a moment ago: look again.
lines.machine.changed.title: Look Again
lines.machine.delivered.stand: {part}, back from {shop}: on the engine stand
lines.partshop.detail.closing: Closing-down sale: {discount}% off everything, and less still in the last {finalDays} days. Last day {day:dddd, MMMM d}.
lines.partshop.detail.closing_final: Closing-down sale: {discount}% off whatever is left, as low as it goes. Last day {day:dddd, MMMM d}.
lines.partshop.lot.sale: CLOSING DOWN · {discount}% OFF EVERYTHING · last day {day:dddd}
lines.partshop.lot.sale_last_day: CLOSING DOWN · {discount}% OFF EVERYTHING · today is the last day
lines.partshop.good_customer: One of their best customers: {discount}% off
lines.partshop.haggle.yes.title: A Deal
partshop.haggle.yes: The owner looks the {part} over, spits, and says {price:money}. Down from {was:money}.
"For you? {price:money}, and you carry it out yourself." That's {was:money} knocked down.
lines.partshop.haggle.no.title: No Deal
partshop.haggle.no: "{was:money} for the {part}. Take it or leave it."
The owner laughs. "{was:money}, and that's already a steal."
